description: Balance for one Monero address using a view key: total, unlocked and pending XMR, with the scanned window and a completion flag. When to use: an agent or merchant wants to know how much an address holds right now, or whether incoming funds have unlocked, without running a wallet. Do not use: for payment proof (xmr_verify_payment) or history (xmr_merchant_report). Returns: balance_xmr, unlocked_xmr, pending_xmr, scanned_to_height, chain_tip, complete. View key can read but never spend and is discarded after the call.
name: xmr_wallet_balance
